newsitem.title: UK: Med oil products end lower, activity modest.
newsitem.headline: Med oil products end lower, activity modest.

text.p: Mediterranean oil products were a touch easier on Thursday, traders said.
Gasoline was slightly lower as weaker crude prices and NYMEX gasoline prices counterbalanced the effect of tight supply.
Traders said supply remained snug in Italy as retailers sought to replenish stocks ahead of two long weekends at the end of April and beginning of May that are expected to increase consumer demand.
Some refiners in the region said they had curtailed maintenance programmes to meet the demand.
Naphtha remained fairly tight but traders said demand remained fairly lacklustre.
Fuel oil markets were generally quiet, with low sulphur slightly weaker, held down by parlous straight-run prices and a looming overhang of material in the north.

A low sulphur cargo was indicated at around $99 cif but not purchased. One 25kt packet was traded at an unknown price to a British-based trader and a 0.5 percent sulphur packet was heard moved at high fob +$3.50.
High sulphur was still supported by talk but trade was quiet.
Gas oil continued to be underpinned by Asian demand which has thinned availability of cargoes. Traders also said there was fair local buying interest.

Non Russian 0.2 percent material was still able to command around high fob quotes +$4 while Russian material, if it could be found would go for high fob quotes +4-5 for the larger "arb friendly" cargoes.
